cause: The retained production Compose frontend healthcheck used http://localhost:80/. BusyBox wget resolved localhost to [::1], while nginx accepted 127.0.0.1:80; the IPv6 connection was refused even though the host-facing root returned HTTP 200.
repair: Stage4 task override changes only the frontend healthcheck target to http://127.0.0.1:80/; the exact r13x frontend image remains unchanged.
